stem: Which sentence from the letter best supports the author’s claim that reading helps writers develop their skills?

options.label: A
options.text: Without practice, you will never learn to hear and sing your own unique song.

options.label: B
options.text: Revising is now one of my favorite parts of being a writer, though I didn’t always feel that way.

options.label: C
options.text: We’re curious to see what others are doing with words, but—what is more important—we like what happens to us when we open a book, how we journey into the pages.

options.label: D
options.text: In the last twenty years, I’ve spent more and more time writing my own books for children and adults.
